name: Captain’s Horn
body:
Aura moderate divination; CL 10th; Slot headband; Price 40,000 gp; Weight 0.1 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

The captain’s horn is a set of ten earrings that are generally worn by a captain and up to nine of his crew members. The earrings allow the wearers to communicate telepathically with one another (as the spell telepathic bond), the master earring alone granting the power to send a message to all the others at once. A wearer can only communicate with other wearers so long as he is not more than 60 ft. away from a ship and can only communicate with those who themselves are also not more than 60 ft. away from the same ship.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, telepathic bond; Cost 20,000 gp
